text:
elaine: Heads-up: need a rapid decision on Dedicated autoscale cooldown vs ramp window. Two pilots (AcmePay, Cartly) require burst beyond reserved pool for 30m, but finance wants clear billing model. Can we align before EOD?
sam: Can we separate autoscale phases? ramp window = allow gradual add of nodes over X minutes, cooldown = prevent immediate drain. Proposal: ramp 10m, cooldown 15m, burst cap = reserved + 20% for 30m.
robert: Operationally cooldown 15m is fine. Concern: burst cap enforcement needs fair spillover rules to avoid noisy tenants causing SLO violations.
maya: Customer ask: they want guaranteed capacity for spikes up to 2x for 15m w/o additional commit. That's a sales promise; we need to map to billing.
karen-cs: From CS: both customers expect SLA for latency during burst. We should require perf tests: p95 < 500ms during 15m simulated spike.
sam: Agree on perf test. Also need metrics for billing: token-usage vs reserved headroom. Suggest we bill burst usage as 'overage' with soft cap and notify at 80%.
elaine: Launch criteria draft: (1) autoscale policy implemented (ramp+cooldown config) (2) per-tenant burst ledger + billing flag (3) perf test harness and dashboard (4) fallbacks (route to lower-cost model).
robert: Fallbacks: route to cheaper GPU or lower-precision model; need owner for routing decisions. I volunteer infra for routing heuristics.
maya: Sales alignment: if we promise 2x 15m no commit, we need a churn guard. Recommending 'one free burst per week' per tenant then billed. OK?
sam: Implementation note: config example:
```
autoscale:
  ramp_window: 600  # seconds
  cooldown: 900     # seconds
  burst:
    soft_cap_pct: 20
    duration_secs: 1800
    free_bursts_per_week: 1
```
Edge: scheduler needs to respect per-pool limits.
elaine: Good, add QA tests: synthetic spike generator, load profiles for small/large tenants, billing reconciliation check. Timeline: beta in 3 weeks.
karen-cs: Add customer acceptance criteria: run two canary bursts with vendor present, confirm latency & error budget usage, sign-off from customer.
robert: Monitoring: create alert if burst causes p99 latency > 1s or error rate > 0.5% during window. Also track 'burst-spill' metric.
maya: :thumbsup: I'll align customers and draft contract language for 'one free weekly burst' and overage rate.
sam: Need decision: should burst be globally pooled or per-tenant escrow? Per-tenant escrow simpler for billing but less efficient. Recommendation: start per-tenant, then allow pooled optionality.
elaine: Decision: start per-tenant escrow for beta to minimize billing disputes. Long-term 1Q later evaluate pooled model. Action items: @sam implement config, @robert add alerts & fallback route, @karen-cs schedule canaries, @maya draft contract language. I'll own launch checklist.
deploy-bot: Reminder: feature branch prod-ops/autoscale-burst created. CI checks passing.
sam: ETA: PR ready in 5 days for internal review.
elaine: Thanks everyone. Finalize docs in console -> Dedicated -> Autoscale. We'll reconvene after PR review.
